name: Coffee & Fox
storyline:
You take over a small café called MoonValley in a quiet fantasy town.
As you run the café, you’ll meet new friends — and maybe even enemies — while discovering and serving unique drinks.
Every day brings unexpected moments, small stories, and memories that make each visit to MoonValley feel special.
summary: Coffee & Fox is a cozy 2D pixel art café game where you serve drinks, meet furry characters, and uncover stories in the charming world of MoonValley.
